notes.title: Update Notes for March 13th
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Update the base libraries the game uses to improve platform stability & support
[*] Improved steam crash reporting so that I can track crashes faster
[*] Fixed a bug with the roll
[*] Improved the exception handling of the game
[*] Fixed a bug of the game not starting correctly (getting stuck loading)
[*] Fixed a bug with the sound in certain systems
[*] A few other minor bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes and some performance improvements
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for reporting issues with the game and sending me the files necessary for me to improve on the issues. I’ve pushed a new update which should fix some of the issues and improve the performance for some of the users that were experiencing unusual issues.


Please let me know if any issues you might find or you are still experiencing,

notes.title: Hotfix for sound and camera
notes.notes: This update improves the camera freedom and fixes the game not having sound on certain computers.
